verdicts.reason: Summary says he built an AI agent in Go to understand harnesses ("construyó un agente de inteligencia artificial en Go"), the main claim, though the Anthropic API is not mentioned.
Summary only mentions understanding "los bucles agénticos" without explaining the model answer/tool call cycle or the outer REPL loop.

Summary says he implemented subagents that handle tasks and whose progress is monitored ("implementando subagentes que gestionen tareas como crear archivos y monitorear su progreso"), though worktree/goroutine details are absent.
Summary says these are "wrappers sencillos alrededor de llamadas a LLMs", stresses learning by building step by step, and that they are not for production.
Summary says "El repositorio Build Your Own Harness ofrece ejercicios" as a separate resource, without presenting it as the project in the video.
